chapter_title: Madam Rides the Bus & The Tale of Custard the Dragon

questions.question_text: How old was Valliammai (Valli) in 'Madam Rides the Bus'?
What was the one-way bus fare to town?

sections.section_name: Section B (Short Answer Questions & Marking Scheme)

questions.question_text: How did Valli collect details and save money for her bus journey?
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Valli listened to neighbors' conversations to learn fare (30 paise) and duration (45 mins). She saved 60 paise by resisting temptations for peppermints, toys, and merry-go-round rides.

questions.question_text: Why did the bus conductor call Valli 'Madam'?
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Because 8-year-old Valli spoke with dignified authority, refused physical help boarding, and insisted on paying her own fare like an independent adult.

teacher_rubric_overlay.evaluation_criteria: Strict textual evidence alignment, grammar clarity, and structural coherence.
teacher_rubric_overlay.marking_guidelines: Full marks for comprehensive evidence-backed points.

questions.question_text: What funny sight made Valli laugh heartily on her outward journey?
options: B) A young cow running wildly in front of the bus
D) A boy chasing his hat
questions.correct_answer: B) A young cow running wildly in front of the bus

questions.question_text: In Ogden Nash's ballad, what did Custard the dragon cry for?

sections.section_name: Section B (Short Answer Questions & Marking Scheme)

questions.question_text: Why did Valli refuse to get off the bus at the town station?
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Valli only wanted the experience of riding the bus. She had no extra money for shopping or cold drinks and needed to return on the same bus before her mother woke up.

questions.question_text: Contrast the claimed bravery of Belinda's pets with their action during the pirate attack.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Ink, Blink, and Mustard claimed to be brave enough to chase lions down stairs or rage like tigers, but fled in terror when a pirate broke in. Custard charged and ate the pirate.

teacher_rubric_overlay.evaluation_criteria: Strict textual evidence alignment, grammar clarity, and structural coherence.

questions.question_text: What tragic sight extinguished Valli's joy on her return journey?
options: B) The same cow lying dead on the roadside
questions.correct_answer: B) The same cow lying dead on the roadside

questions.question_text: What weapons was the pirate carrying in Ogden Nash's poem?
options: B) Pistols in both hands and a cutlass in his teeth
questions.correct_answer: B) Pistols in both hands and a cutlass in his teeth

sections.section_name: Section B (Short Answer Questions & Marking Scheme)

questions.question_text: How did seeing the dead cow mark Valli's initiation into the reality of mortality?
questions.marking_scheme_answer: The playful cow she enjoyed on the outward trip was now a grotesque, lifeless corpse. The sudden realization of life's vulnerability saddened her deeply, ending her childhood innocence.

questions.question_text: How does Ogden Nash use comic rhyme and satire in 'The Tale of Custard the Dragon'?
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Nash uses exaggerated descriptions, inventive words ('realio, trulio'), and ironic character flips to satire empty human boasting versus genuine action in crisis.

teacher_rubric_overlay.evaluation_criteria: Strict textual evidence alignment, grammar clarity, and structural coherence.

options: B) 1:00 PM to 2:45 PM during her mother's nap
questions.correct_answer: B) 1:00 PM to 2:45 PM during her mother's nap

questions.question_text: What color was Mustard, Belinda's pet dog?

sections.section_name: Section B (Short Answer Questions & Marking Scheme)

questions.question_text: Describe Valli's self-restraint at the village fair when saving money.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Valli firmly suppressed her child desires to buy peppermints, balloons, and toys. She even stood looking at the village merry-go-round without spending a single coin.

questions.question_text: Describe Custard's fight against the pirate step-by-step.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Custard snorted like an engine, clashed his tail like irons in a dungeon, charged the pirate like a robin at a worm, and swallowed him whole.

What did Ink and Blink do when the pirate broke in?
options: B) Ink fled to bottom of house; Blink hid in mouse hole
questions.correct_answer: B) Ink fled to bottom of house; Blink hid in mouse hole

sections.section_name: Section B (Short Answer Questions & Marking Scheme)

questions.question_text: How does Valli prove that children possess remarkable planning and execution skills?
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Valli systematically gathered route data, saved exact fare money through self-discipline, timed her travel within a safe window, and managed round-trip travel independently.

questions.question_text: What lesson does 'The Tale of Custard the Dragon' teach about true courage?
questions.marking_scheme_answer: The poem teaches that true courage is revealed through action during actual danger, whereas empty boasting about bravery often collapses under pressure.
